content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: NLC India Limited has invited online applications from experienced professionals for executive-level vacancies in engineering, scientific, human resources, legal and security disciplines. The important recruitment details are given below.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 145 vacancies have been announced under NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026. The posts are distributed across Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Control and Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, Scientific, Chemical, Mining, Safety, Human Resources, Legal and Security disciplines.

NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NLC India Executive posts must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and relevant post-qualification work experience. The eligibility requirements vary according to the post and discipline. Important: The experience requirements include specific areas of work, responsibilities and technical conditions. content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 depends on the applicable grade and category. Age will be calculated as on 1 November 2026 . Age relaxation for reserved categories, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities and Ex-Servicemen will be applicable according to the notification. Category-based relaxation is subject to the availability of applicable reserved vacancies and other conditions. The maximum age after relaxation is generally limited to 58 years.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salary according to the applicable executive grade. The notification specifies the following pay scales and approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC). The company also provides applicable benefits, including Performance Related Pay, medical facilities and group insurance according to its rules. Residential accommodation may be provided subject to eligibility and availability. These pay scales are not equivalent to fixed monthly take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay the prescribed application and processing fees through the online payment facility. The total fee for UR, EWS and OBC (NCL) candidates includes an application fee of Rs. 500 and a processing fee of Rs. 354. SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from the application fee but must pay the processing fee of Rs. 354. The payment is non-refundable, and additional bank service charges may apply.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Important: The extended final submission window until 22 December 2026 is available only for candidates who completed registration and fee payment within the prescribed deadlines. It is not an extension of the registration closing date.

rows.event: Final Application Submission for Candidates Already Registered and Paid

content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies according to the discipline. The official notification specifies separate procedures for Legal posts and other executive positions. Selection for Deputy Manager (Legal) will be based on a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Personal Interview. Computer Based Test: 80 Marks Personal Interview: 20 Marks Minimum Qualifying Marks in CBT: 50% Interview shortlisting ratio: 1:6, subject to the notification Final merit based on combined CBT and interview marks For disciplines other than Legal, selection will be based on a Personal Interview. If the number of eligible applicants exceeds the prescribed shortlisting ratio, NLC India Limited may conduct a Screening Test through CBT before the interview. The minimum qualifying marks in the Personal Interview are 50% for UR / EWS candidates and 40% for SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / PwBD candidates against applicable reserved posts. Candidates must also satisfy document verification and medical fitness requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official NLC India Limited website. The registration facility will open on 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLC India Executive Application
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready when submitting the online application: Proof of date of birth Aadhaar card Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Relevant professional registration or competency certificates, where applicable Post-qualification experience certificates Documents supporting the prescribed area and duration of experience Applicable category or reservation certificates Relevant employment and pay-related documents Other documents required for the selected post Applicants must upload documents in the format and size prescribed in the official notification. Failure to provide sufficient evidence of eligibility may result in rejection of the application.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The NLC India Executive online application facility will be available from 20 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Eligible candidates must complete online registration by 19 December 2026 at 5:00 PM and pay the applicable fee within the notified deadline. Apply Online: NLC India Official Recruitment Website

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 145 vacancies available for various executive and managerial positions across different disciplines in NLC India Limited for the 2026 recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 19 December 2026 at 5:00 PM, and fee payment closes at 11:45 PM on the same day. Candidates who register and pay within these deadlines can complete final application submission until 22 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 854 for UR/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates and Rs. 354 for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen candidates, payable via SBI E-Collect.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Computer Based Test (CBT) for legal discipline and a Personal Interview for other disciplines. A screening test may be conducted if the number of applicants is high.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply offline?
faq.answer: No, the application process is strictly online. Candidates must visit the official website at www.nlcindia.in to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for UR/EWS candidates ranges from 30 to 52 years depending on the executive grade, as on 1 November 2026. Category-wise age relaxation applies according to the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any job locations specified?
faq.answer: Yes, the job locations include Neyveli, Barsingsar, Talabira, South Pachwara, Tuticorin, and Ghatampur. Selected candidates may be posted at any of these units.

faq.question: Q8. What is the probation period?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed on a probation period of one year from the date of their appointment into the organization.

faq.question: Q9. Is experience required?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must possess the required years of post-qualification experience in their relevant area of expertise as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates who have been previously removed, terminated, or have deserted their employment from NLC India Limited are not eligible to apply for these positions.
